pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit rounded-to-polygonal geometry with soft, smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. The spatial area of individual patches is significantly larger on the neck and mid-flank compared to smaller, more densely clustered patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous intersecting network of pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections. Pathway thickness appears relatively uniform across the flank, though edge definition is diffuse due to image resolution.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette is visible along the upper neck and shoulder line, representing the mane contour against the background.
